title: Trump pitches Apple's Tim Cook as new Nvidia CEO
source: Axios — Trump pitches Apple's Tim Cook as new Nvidia CEO (2026-11-12)
body: President Trump is backing Apple executive chairman Tim Cook to replace tech giant Jensen Huang after Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, though it's unclear whether he meant it as a joke. The big picture: Trump didn't weigh in on the controversy surrounding Huang's departure following alleged affairs with a suspected Chinese spy and an Nvidia executive, instead calling Huang "a Legend" in his Truth Social post . Editor's note: This is a breaking news story and will be updated.
